description: Test suite for the update-offset-store module managing Telegram update offsets. Contains unit tests verifying reading, writing, and deleting offset data with various edge cases.

methods.name: deleteTelegramUpdateOffset
methods.description: Deletes the stored Telegram update offset for a given account ID, optionally considering bot token for validation.

methods.name: readTelegramUpdateOffset
methods.description: Reads the stored Telegram update offset, with optional validation against a provided bot token.

methods.name: writeTelegramUpdateOffset
methods.description: Stores the Telegram update offset for an account, with validation on the update ID to be non-negative.
